preconditions.description: The number of actions is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each action is in the format 'X posted on Y's wall', 'X commented on Y's post', or 'X likes Y's post'
preconditions.description: Each action is one of the three specified formats.

preconditions.expression: All names are lowercase and consist of at least 1 letter and at most 10 letters.
preconditions.description: All names in the input are in the specified format.

preconditions.expression: Your name is given as the first input.
preconditions.description: The first line of input is your name.

postconditions.expression: The output contains m lines, where m is the number of distinct names in the input (excluding yourself).
postconditions.description: The output includes all distinct names from the input, excluding your own name.

postconditions.expression: The output names are sorted by the priority factor with you in descending order.
postconditions.description: The output names are sorted based on the sum of points received from actions involving them and you.

postconditions.expression: If two or more names have the same priority factor, they are sorted alphabetically.
postconditions.description: Names with the same priority factor are sorted lexicographically.
